name: Greek Mythology Titans
title: Greek Mythology Titans
description: Titans and Titanesses from ancient Greek mythology, the elder gods who preceded the Olympians.

rows.name: Asteria
rows.description: Titaness of nocturnal oracles and falling stars.

rows.name: Astraeus
rows.description: Titan of dusk, stars, and planets, and the art of astrology.

rows.name: Atlas
rows.description: Titan forced to carry the heavens upon his shoulders by Zeus. Also Son of Iapetus.

rows.name: Aura
rows.description: Titaness of the breeze and the fresh, cool air of early morning.

rows.name: Clymene
rows.description: Titaness of renown, fame, and infamy, and wife of Iapetus.

rows.name: Dione
rows.description: Titaness of the oracle of Dodona.

rows.name: Helios
rows.description: Titan of the sun and guardian of oaths.

rows.name: Selene
rows.description: Titaness of the moon.

rows.name: Eos
rows.description: Titaness of the dawn.

rows.name: Epimetheus
rows.description: Titan of afterthought and the father of excuses.

rows.name: Eurybia
rows.description: Titaness of the mastery of the seas and consort of Krios.

rows.name: Eurynome
rows.description: Titaness of water-meadows and pasturelands, and mother of the three Charites by Zeus.

rows.name: Lelantos
rows.description: Titan of air and the hunter's skill of stalking prey. He is the male counterpart of Leto.

rows.name: Leto
rows.description: Titaness of motherhood and mother of the twin Olympians, Artemis and Apollo.

rows.name: Menoetius
rows.description: Titan of violent anger, rash action, and human mortality. Killed by Zeus.

rows.name: Metis
rows.description: Titaness of good counsel, advice, planning, cunning, craftiness, and wisdom. Mother of Athena.

rows.name: Ophion
rows.description: An elder Titan, in some versions of the myth he ruled the Earth with his consort Eurynome before Cronus overthrew him. Another account describes him as a snake, born from the "World Egg"

rows.name: Pallas
rows.description: Titan of warcraft. He was killed by Athena during the Titanomachy.

rows.name: Perses
rows.description: Titan of destruction.

rows.name: Prometheus
rows.description: Titan of forethought and crafty counsel, and creator of mankind.

rows.name: Styx
rows.description: Titaness of the Underworld river Styx and personification of hatred.
